# Your account

> Your reading account on customers.riskmandate.ai: the balance you started with, every page you opened and what it cost by how far you read, what you asked not to be charged for, and your top-ups. Kept in this browser only; nothing is sent anywhere.

*Source: <https://customers.riskmandate.ai/account/> · site v0.2.5 (2026-10-21) · this file is generated from the same content as the page, so the two cannot drift. Every page on this site has a `.md` twin; internal links below point at them.*

---

Everything you have done here, and everything this site keeps about it: your credit and where it went, the examples you watched and how far, what you answered, what you sent us, and your settings. All of it lives in this browser and nowhere else; we see none of it unless you send it. Everyone starts with **£50.00** of credit for reading, not money: nothing is billed and nothing is ever blocked.

<a id="account-live"></a>

Your balance and history are drawn here from this browser; with JavaScript off there is nothing to show.

## What this is, and what it is not

- **It lives in this browser.** The balance and the history are kept in this browser's storage under `riskmandate.customers.meter.v1` and are sent nowhere. Another browser starts again at £50.00; *Export everything* keeps a copy, and *Delete everything* removes it.
- **It is an honesty box, not a paywall.** The meter is [SG Meter](https://newsroom.sgit.ai/meter/), loaded from [api.newsroom.sgit.ai](https://api.newsroom.sgit.ai/) at a pinned release; this page is this site's own view of it. What the meter can and cannot protect is in [its security model](https://newsroom.sgit.ai/meter/security.html).
- **The prices are a starting point.** [What each page costs](/credit/index.md). If a page was not worth its price, [tell us](/feedback/index.md).
